title: Study of PFAS in Michigan Agricultural Systems
overview: The Michigan Department of Agriculture and Rural Development (MDARD) is requesting proposals for single- or multi-year research projects that will aid in the understanding, management, or mitigation of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substance (PFAS) contamination on Michigan agricultural lands. Qualified researchers at universities and colleges, including community and Tribal colleges, are eligible to be principal investigators. At least one principal investigator is required to be from a Michigan institution of higher education. Project team members may include people from non-governmental organizations, consulting firms, Tribal agencies, or other relevant organizations. An individual may not be a PI or co-PI on more than two applications. Research questions must clearly relate to State needs and priorities. Any field work outside of Michigan must include clear justification for its applicability in state. Projects span 1 to 4 years. A required Letter of Intent is due by April 20, 2026. Invited applicants must submit a full proposal as a single PDF via email to MDARD-research@michigan.gov by June 1, 2026. Show More
